title: OAuth 2.0 Support for Goals and Projects API
description:
You can now authenticate to the Goals and projects APIs through OAuth2.0 (both 2LO and 3LO), instead of relying on personal tokens. For OAuth 2.0 (2LO) apps are created and managed in Atlassian Administration: Go to Atlassian Administration. Select your organization if you have more than one.
	Select Directory > Service accounts.
	Select the service account you want to create a credential for.
	Select Create credentials.
	Select OAuth 2.0, then select Next.
